card.name: Dose unit just before tazobactam
card.fires_on: The unit or letter right before the word tazobactam, mostly in ZERBAXA dose tables such as '0.5 g' or '20 mg/kg' after 'ceftolozane and'. It also fires on the start of 'Tazobactam' in piperacillin combinations.

modes.label: Unit before tazobactam
modes.description: The unit (g or /kg) after a number, in 'ceftolozane and X ... tazobactam' dose listings.
modes.example: Provides 1 g ceftolozane and 0.5<< g>> tazobactam.

modes.description: The first letter of tazobactam in a drug pairing.

card.writes: It predicts the next piece of a word, but the promoted tokens are unrelated, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the dose unit just before the drug name tazobactam in a ceftolozane-tazobactam dose list.
